verdict.rationale: Brave ships a dedicated LLM Context endpoint for RAG, tools and chatbots. It returns pre-extracted page content that is token-budgeted, with configurable token and URL limits. Relevance threshold modes filter what reaches the LLM, and Goggles re-ranking lets you control which sources ground it. Extra snippets add up to 5 excerpts per result on standard web search. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of context quality and ranking (the benchmark claim is vendor-only), and detailed docs on the threshold modes and output format.
